note: Each familyKey = one earned scenario. Do not clone with score/minute. Systems are attributes, not automatic multipliers.

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Hold True Width on the Sideline
attack.primaryCue: Standing inside the width collapses the left channel
attack.decision: Hold true left-sideline width vs early cut

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Stretch Wider When Left Back Binds the Wing Defender
attack.primaryCue: LB engages WD; WD hips still on LB
attack.decision: Stay/maximize width to keep the pass alive

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Stay Wide When the Wing Defender Helps Inside
attack.primaryCue: WD chest/hips turn inside to help on LB
attack.decision: Stay wide; do not follow into the crowded half

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Enter Only When the Left Lane Actually Opens
attack.primaryCue: WD overcommits to ball side; path to six opens
attack.decision: Timed entry toward six

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — When NOT to Leave the Corner for an Entry
attack.primaryCue: WD already helping / lane closing; LB still needs width
attack.decision: Stay wide; early entry kills LB space
attack.duplicateRisk: Must stay distinct from stay_wide_inside_help by decision focus (entry temptation vs already-helping hold)

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Back-Door When the Wing Defender Ball-Watches
attack.primaryCue: WD head/chest to far ball; LB about to receive
attack.decision: Cut behind WD to six on next pass

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Take Off After Left Back Pulls the Wing Defender Inside
attack.primaryCue: WD still inside on LB; take-off lane toward middle free
attack.decision: Take off now; finish from GK read, not from folklore

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Closed Take-Off Lane: Do Not Force the Jump
attack.primaryCue: Half/WD recover into take-off line; contact imminent
attack.decision: Delay / recycle / soft inside — do not jump into block

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Ask for the Ball When the Wing Defender’s Hips Open the Lane
attack.primaryCue: WD hips face LB; pass lane from LB to LW open
attack.decision: Demand the ball now

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Delay the Ask When the Pass Lane Is Covered
attack.primaryCue: WD feet/chest cut the LB→LW lane
attack.decision: Hold width; do not force the ask into a steal

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Pivot Block Opens Take-Off Toward the Middle
attack.primaryCue: Pivot seals WD recovery path
attack.decision: Take off into freed lane; then read GK

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Feed the Sealed Pivot Instead of Forcing the Extreme Angle
attack.primaryCue: Pivot sealed; WD recovers on LW body; soft inside lane open
attack.decision: Feed pivot vs forced wing shot

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 1v1 When You Own the Sideline Space
attack.primaryCue: WD isolated; help distance >2m; feet flat
attack.decision: Attack 1v1 take-off / beat vs recycle

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Read Feet and Chest Before Your First Movement
attack.primaryCue: WD feet point inside or chest opens to ball
attack.decision: Choose stay-wide / ask / prepare back-door from that cue

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Goalkeeper Commits Early to the Near Post
attack.primaryCue: Before take-off: GK near foot and near arm move to near post
attack.decision: Available target is far side — contextual, not folklore

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Goalkeeper Shades the Far Side Early
attack.primaryCue: GK far foot/weight committed far; near window opens
attack.decision: Near-side finish if lane and body allow — cue-based

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Goalkeeper Depth Changes the Finish Window
attack.primaryCue: GK deep on line vs stepped; arms high/low stated
attack.decision: Finish choice from depth + hands, not automatic lob/power

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Early Step-Out: Lob Only If Hands Drop and Inside Is Covered
attack.primaryCue: GK steps out; hands/height and LB availability stated
attack.decision: Conditional lob OR soft inside — never automatic lob

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Wait Through the Goalkeeper’s Late Movement
attack.primaryCue: GK late first step during take-off; contact not yet forcing release
attack.decision: Patience to abandoned corner vs early release into hands

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Extreme Angle: Body and Goalkeeper Cue Before Release
attack.primaryCue: Sliver of goal + GK shade + help distance
attack.decision: Playable skim / recycle — hand tag only if fork is hand-dependent
attack.handednessNote: May become left/right only if two optimal paths truly diverge by throwing hand

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — First Wave 2v1: Finish or Extra Pass
attack.primaryCue: Numbers 2v1; recovering defender commits to ball or LW
attack.decision: Shoot vs give the extra pass

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — First Wave 3v2: Hold the Left Width
attack.primaryCue: Middle covered by recovering defender; left lane free
attack.decision: Stay wide to six as pass option — do not crowd middle

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — First Wave: Arrive With the Catch on the Six
attack.primaryCue: Outlet released; one recovering body between LW and six
attack.decision: Sprint timing so catch and six arrive together

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Second Wave: Stop Forcing When Advantage Is Gone
attack.primaryCue: Recovering defenders restore numbers; no free lane
attack.decision: Hold width into positional attack

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Partially Set Defence: One More Advantage Action
attack.primaryCue: Defence half-set; WD late on left
attack.decision: One more advantage action vs full reset

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Choose the Left Running Lane Against Recovery
attack.primaryCue: Recovery path of nearest defender stated
attack.decision: Wide lane vs inside lane to keep the advantage

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 6v5: Finish When Free and Help Is Late
attack.primaryCue: Nearest help >2m from take-off; LW free at width
attack.decision: Finish now

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 6v5: Feed the Sealed Pivot Before Rotation Closes
attack.primaryCue: Pivot sealed; late middle rotation coming
attack.decision: Feed pivot / attack rotation — distinct from free finish
attack.duplicateRisk: Must not be score-sticker twin of lw_6v5_free_finish

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 5v6: Do Not Donate a Counter From the Corner
attack.primaryCue: Down a player; WD closing; risky extreme angle
attack.decision: Safe recycle / high-percentage only

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Extra Attacker / Empty Opponent Goal: Only If the Left Picture Is Clean
attack.primaryCue: Extra attacker or empty opp goal PLUS concrete LW freedom/risk
attack.decision: Finish vs keep possession discipline
attack.assumptionFlag: Include only one; do not farm empty-opp variants

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Empty Own Goal: Safe Finish or Safe Return
attack.primaryCue: Own goal empty; catch quality / body orientation / opp wing threat stated
attack.decision: High-percentage finish vs safe return

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Passive Warning: Create a Real End, Not a Panic Shot
attack.primaryCue: Passive signal; WD distance; LB/pivot options
attack.decision: Best real end from width vs panic extreme

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Late Lead: Do Not Gift the Counter From a Marginal Angle
attack.primaryCue: Lead late + marginal angle + turnover risk stated
attack.decision: Safe recycle / clear high-% only — risk changes the decision

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Late Trail: Take the Clean Chance You Are Given
attack.primaryCue: Trail late + free take-off / clear cue
attack.decision: Take the clean chance vs over-reset

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Short Clock: One Decision From the Stated Picture
attack.primaryCue: Clock + concrete freedom or blocked lane
attack.decision: Immediate end vs impossible force
attack.duplicateRisk: Must differ from late_lead/trail by clock-forced fork, not score sticker

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 5:1: Time Width Against the Advanced Defender
attack.primaryCue: Advanced defender position relative to LB/LW lane
attack.decision: Ask/hold width vs premature entry — would differ in 6:0

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 3:2:1: Wing vs Half Responsibility Window
attack.primaryCue: Half steps out; wing responsibility lag stated
attack.decision: Exploit lag / hold for LB — system-specific

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 3:3: Release From Man Pressure Without Crowding LB
attack.primaryCue: Man pressure on LW; help/switch picture
attack.decision: Width release / back-door / recycle

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 4:2: Attack the Left Corridor Timing
attack.primaryCue: Front line vs back line gap on left
attack.decision: Entry/take-off timing unique to 4:2

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 1:5: Keep Outlet Width Under Deep Pressure
attack.primaryCue: Deep press / high chase on left outlet
attack.decision: Safe width outlet vs trapped ask

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 5+1: Do Not Walk Into the Long-Range Trap
attack.primaryCue: Advanced chaser + base wall on left
attack.decision: Width/timing that differs from plain 6:0

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — 4+2: Choose the Open Left Lane
attack.primaryCue: Two advanced defenders create a specific left gap
attack.decision: Lane choice / ask timing

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Open Defence: Attack Isolation or Reject Crowding Help
attack.primaryCue: Man orientation + help distance
attack.decision: 1v1 attack vs reset — distinct from structured 6:0 entry

attack.titleEn: Left Wing — Finish Before the Recovering Defender Closes
attack.primaryCue: Recovering body one step away; GK position concrete
attack.decision: Immediate controlled finish vs wait for contact
attack.existingSource: rebuild far-post/centred idea without automatic far-post rule

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — Protect the Pass to the Opposing Wing
defence.primaryCue: Ball on opposite/backcourt moving to opp RW
defence.decision: Deny wing pass / body on lane
defence.teamRule: State if zone responsibility requires staying attached

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — Controlled Inside Help Without Abandoning the Wing
defence.primaryCue: LB threat inside; opp wing still a pass threat

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — Handover Timing With the Half Defender
defence.primaryCue: Handover call / half arrives; ball side stated
defence.decision: Release only after handover is real

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — When NOT to Abandon the Wing
defence.primaryCue: Opp wing free / ball reversing; help already present inside

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — Defend Left Back / Wing Cooperation on Your Side
defence.primaryCue: Opp LB binds you then looks wing

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — Defend the Opposing Wing Entry
defence.primaryCue: Opp wing starts entry behind you

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — Deny Back-Door When You Ball-Watch
defence.primaryCue: Temptation to watch far ball; opp wing behind
defence.decision: Chest/feel contact; do not lose the runner

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — Transition Defence: Close Your Own-Side Passing Lane
defence.primaryCue: Turnover; opp outlet toward your former wing side

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — Transition Defence: Far Skip Only With a Teammate Map
defence.primaryCue: Teammate locations stated; far-wing skip is real threat
defence.decision: Cut far skip vs protect own wing — A/B must not both be correct

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — Communicate With the Half Before You Leave
defence.decision: Help only after communication / confirmed cover

defence.primaryCue: Set 6:0; ball far; opp wing width

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — 5:1: Wing Job Against the Advanced Pair
defence.primaryCue: Advanced defender interactions with your side

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — 3:3: Switch / Stay on Man Pressure
defence.decision: Switch vs stay — rule must be in situation text

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — 5v6 Defence: Protect the Most Dangerous Pass First
defence.primaryCue: Down a defender; most dangerous pass stated
defence.decision: Priority cover without gambling the wing randomly

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — Recover Back to the Wing After Inside Help
defence.primaryCue: Help done; ball reversing to opp wing
defence.decision: Sprint recover to wing before skip arrives

defence.titleEn: Left Wing — After Turnover With Empty Own Goal: First Sprint Priority
defence.primaryCue: Own GK out; turnover; opp numbers/lane stated
defence.decision: First defensive sprint priority (lane/body) — not hero foul folklore
